method: Documented flux-unit transfer into nJy, robust sigma-clipped plane subtraction per side, empirical stellar-FWHM measurement, and Gaussian convolution to a common target FWHM, followed by a post-match registration audit against the declared 0.30 arcsec threshold.

policy.note: Clearing PSF, background, and unit blockers does not license a quantitative claim. Bandpass transfer and injection/recovery QA still gate every difference.
